title: Practice: Dropping in, going down: за- and с-

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: He escaped under cover of darkness.
exercises.why: «с-»: сбежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Maybe I went a little too far.
exercises.why: «за-»: зайти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I've got a new word processor.
exercises.why: «за-»: завести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Haven't you been to the supermarket?
exercises.why: «за-»: заезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«за-»: заходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я сегодня ___ (забегать), но вас не было дома.
exercises.prompt: I stopped by today, but you weren't home.
exercises.why: «за-»: забегать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«с-»: свести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Сколько яиц в неделю ___ (сносить) эта курица?
exercises.prompt: How many eggs does this hen lay each week?
exercises.why: «с-»: сносить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«с-»: сходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: All my settings got wiped out.
exercises.why: «с-»: слететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«за-»: занести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«со-»: сойти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: When was the Berlin Wall torn down?
exercises.why: «с-»: снести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В рот, закрытый глухо, не ___ (залететь) муха.
exercises.prompt: A fly does not fly into a shut mouth.
exercises.why: «за-»: залететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
